name: My Gorgeous Wife
original_name: คุณภรรยาคนสวย
overview:
Ki, a northern farming girl, finds herself tied to Khwan, the beautiful, high-status daughter of a major businessman from the city, when a business deal results in a one-year marriage agreement. The union, which begins with coldness, pride, and hatred from the bride who declares that she would never look at another woman, gradually begins to waver due to the heart-trembling intimacy of sharing a bedroom every night.

However, this path of fake love is not so easy as it's revealed that Khwan's close friend is Ki's ex, and things didn't end well between them. Moreover, Khwan is already engaged, leading to a tangled web of love and jealousy.
